'''''Carex panicea''''', commonly known as '''carnation sedge''', is a [[plant]] species in the sedge family, [[Cyperaceae]]. It is known as grass-like sedge and can be found in [[Northern Europe|Northern]] and [[Western Europe]], and also in north-eastern [[North America]].<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.discoverlife.org/mp/20m?kind=Carex+panicea|title=''Carex panicea''|publisher=Discover Life|accessdate=August 28, 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://plants.usda.gov/java/profile?symbol=CAPA30|title=''Carex panicea'' L. (grass-like sedge)|publisher=PLANTS Profile|work=[[United States Department of Agriculture|USDA]]|access-date=August 28, 2012}}</ref> The plant produces [[fruit]]s which are {{convert|3|-|4|mm}} long, are [[egg]] shaped and spiked. Both male and female species leaves are pale blue on both sides.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.plant-identification.co.uk/skye/cyperaceae/carex-panicea.htm|title=West Highland Flora|publisher=Plant Identification|accessdate= October 6, 2012}}</ref>
